_source: Brief 5 overnight item 5. READ-ONLY scan of C:/Users/Admin/UE5LandscapePipeline/_verify/bench by scripts (scratchpad) on 2026-09-19. No editor, no new captures.
_what: Manifest of every dolly frame (PNG) already on disk for the desk's temporal (pop / temporal-CSF) tool. Covers the four E4 3 s sunlit dolly captures plus the one related non-E4 6 s ratified-dolly subset. 'index' is the integer frame number parsed from the frame_NNNN.png filename; 'consecutive_pairs' reference POSITIONS in the frames[] array (0-based).
ordering_key: integer frame number in the filename 'frame_<N>.png' (N is zero-padded to 4 digits, MRQ file_name_format 'frame_{frame_number}'). Frames sorted ascending by N within each capture set.
consecutive_pairs_definition: adjacent entries in frames[] that belong to the SAME capture set AND whose frame indices differ by exactly 1. Pairs are given as [i, j] positions into frames[]. The 2026-09-06 dev set is a stride-10 subset (indices 0,10,20,...) so it contributes NO consecutive pairs.
_camera_provenance: NO per-frame camera sidecar exists on disk: the frame directories contain PNGs only, and the capture sidecars record the dolly at SET level, not per frame. Per-frame camera fields are therefore null (rule 9/13: not inferred). The dolly is a straight LINEAR move (no easing) at 1.4 m/s built by scripts/payloads/bench_make_dolly.py from the 'Bench_near_ground' station camera read-back; pitch/roll come from the actor, only yaw may be overridden. Set-level path facts that ARE recorded live in each set's sidecar (see per_set[].sidecar) and in bench_make_dolly.py's stdout (not persisted to disk). The near_ground station location is derived as [-210800.0, 278800.0, ~18849] cm in _verify/bench/2026-09-05/bench_stations_derived.json, but that file flags its Z as a derivation aid, NOT the camera Z -- so it is not used here as a camera transform.
_sun_provenance: sun_elevation_deg is null per frame: no dolly sidecar records a sun elevation. The world sun is a STATIC directional light at elevation 12.0 deg (recipes/alpine_8k.json /lighting/sun/elevation_deg); because it does not move during a capture it applies to every frame, but it is recorded at world level, not as a per-frame capture field, so it is surfaced only as _world_sun_elevation_deg below and left null per frame.
